cavor.scope: Carbonaceous feedstock, steam/oxygen gasification, hydrogen-rich syngas.

pem.scope: Pt/Ir catalyst inventory; do not copy terrestrial system cost/efficiency into a space plant.

leach.title: Hydrochloric attack of serpentinites
leach.scope: HCl dissolution of Mg-bearing silicates, silica residue and dissolved co-metals.

leach_equation.scope: Endmember leaching chemistry; actual asteroid mineral reaction extents unknown.

precip.title: Metso precipitation
precip.scope: Chemical separation hardware; does not validate this complete synthetic flowsheet.

ni_chloride.title: Nickel matte chloride leaching process
ni_chloride.scope: Nickel chloride hydrometallurgy; no automatic transfer of selectivity to C-class mixtures.

ni_reduce.title: Nickel oxide reduction with hydrogen
ni_reduce.scope: NiO-to-Ni chemistry; not validation of this selected thermal reactor.

mg.title: Electrolytic processes for magnesium production
mg.scope: MgCl2 electrolysis, bath and electrode dependencies, chlorine recovery.

mg_dry.title: Hatch fluid-bed dehydration of magnesium chloride
mg_dry.scope: Anhydrous feed is a nontrivial requirement; hydrolysis must be suppressed.

calcium.title: RSC calcium production
calcium.scope: Calcium metal from fused calcium chloride; product needs inert handling.

silicon.title: PCC silicon production technology
silicon.scope: Carbothermic silica reduction, electrodes and offgas treatment.

polysilicon.title: WACKER high-purity silicon production
polysilicon.scope: HCl conversion to TCS and chemical purification; polysilicon is not a finished solar cell.

gas_cleanup.title: PNNL multicontaminant syngas cleanup demonstration
gas_cleanup.scope: Sulfur sorbents and poisoning constraints; extraterrestrial feed not validated.

acid.title: EPA contact sulfuric acid plant process description
acid.scope: SO2 oxidation and SO3 absorption in sulfuric acid.

methane.title: NASA Next Generation Life Support
methane.scope: Sabatier reaction and methane cracking development.

carbon.title: NASA Hydrogen Recovery by Methane Pyrolysis to Elemental Carbon
carbon.scope: Methane-to-carbon/H2 recovery route; carbon grade remains process-dependent.

ammonia.title: Experimental ammonia decomposition in a catalytic reactor
ammonia.scope: NH3 decomposition to N2/H2, conditional on actually recovering ammonia.

mre.title: NASA system modelling of a molten regolith electrolysis plant
mre.scope: Oxygen plus primarily Fe-Si alloy; downstream metal separation remains a gap.

claus.title: Shell Claus sulfur recovery process
claus.scope: Partial H2S oxidation, catalytic sulfur recovery and catalyst inventory.

fes_acid.title: Anoxic dissolution of troilite in acidic media
fes_acid.scope: Troilite acid dissolution releases iron and H2S; passivating layers matter.

chloralkali.title: EU JRC production of chlor-alkali
chloralkali.scope: Brine purification, electrolysis, caustic and gas processing.

dolomite.title: Thermal decomposition of dolomite under CO2
dolomite.scope: Stepwise carbonate decomposition and dependence on CO2 partial pressure.

anorthite.title: Extraction of aluminum from lunar regolith through molten salt electrolysis
anorthite.scope: Laboratory anorthite digestion and separate stock-alumina/CaCl2 electrolysis tests. This is not demonstration of the selected AlCl3 crystallisation plus cryolite Hall-Heroult route or an asteroid plant.

anorthite_F.title: USBM anorthosite HCl-F gas sparging crystallisation
anorthite_F.scope: Feed-specific fluoride activation and AlCl3 hydrate purification; not a universal requirement.

aluminium.title: Aluminium smelting: Australian Aluminium Council
aluminium.scope: Cryolite bath, carbon anodes, electrolysis and metal handling.

ilmenite.title: NASA ilmenite hydrogen reduction
ilmenite.scope: Fe and titanium-oxide products; Ti is not fully reduced to metal by the ideal Fe-removal step.

kroll.title: Osaka Titanium Kroll process
kroll.scope: TiCl4 purification, magnesium reduction and residual Mg/salt vacuum separation.

cobalt.title: Syensqo Cyanex mining applications
cobalt.scope: Co/Ni solvent extraction from chloride or sulfate media; specific multimetal selectivity still requires testing.

chromium.title: USGS Chromium metal production
chromium.scope: Chromate/dichromate/oxide routes and aluminothermic metal production.

chromium_oxide.title: IARC chromium compounds monograph
chromium_oxide.scope: Chromium oxide production via dichromate/sulfur and chromium metal from oxide/aluminium.

phosphate.title: EPA phosphate manufacture processes
phosphate.scope: Sulfuric-acid wet process, gypsum/fluoride streams and carbon/silica furnace production of P.

schreibersite.title: Reactions and oxidation of schreibersite
schreibersite.scope: Mixed P oxyanions from phosphide corrosion; not automatic quantitative phosphoric-acid production.

microgravity_fluids.title: NASA: Microgravity capillary two-phase flows
microgravity_fluids.scope: Spacecraft bubble separation is geometry/flow dependent; this is not validation of molten-metal or acid processing equipment.

brine_polishing.title: Veolia: Chlor-alkali brine purification
brine_polishing.scope: Precipitation, filtration and high-performance ion-exchange softening before membrane electrolysis.

phosphate_wet.title: EPA AP-42 section 8.9: Phosphoric acid
phosphate_wet.scope: Wet-process phosphate acidulation, gypsum, concentration and fluoride partition; does not validate a merrillite flowsheet.

phosphorus_furnace_primary.title: NIOSH field survey: FMC elemental phosphorus manufacture
phosphorus_furnace_primary.scope: Industrial phosphate/coke/silica electric-furnace route, phosphorus condensation, CO and ferrophosphorus byproducts.

acid_contact.title: EPA AP-42 section 8.10: Sulfuric acid
acid_contact.scope: SO2 oxidation and strong-acid SO3 absorption; water is the net reactant, not the sole absorber fluid.

schreibersite_corrosion.title: Gull et al. (2022): Eight-year meteoritic phosphorus extraction
schreibersite_corrosion.scope: Water corrosion releases several P oxyanions; neither this experiment nor surface studies establish the proposed acid/peroxide industrial process.

nickel_thermal.title: Kinetic Analysis of Hydrogen Reduction of Nickel Compounds (2024)
nickel_thermal.scope: Thermogravimetric hydrogen reduction of specified commercial nickel compounds; not qualification of mixed asteroid feed.

silicon_primary.title: High-Purity Silicon America: Production process
silicon_primary.scope: Metallurgical silicon chlorination, repeated TCS distillation and hydrogen reduction on silicon rods.

aluminium_window.title: International Aluminium Institute: Production reduction
aluminium_window.scope: Industrial cryolite/alumina/AlF3 carbon-anode cell, approximately 960–980 C.

mg_lab.title: Feng et al. (2026): Mg electrodeposition in NaCl-KCl-MgCl2
mg_lab.scope: Specific laboratory molten-chloride experiment at 953 K; not a universal plant operating point or transferred purity guarantee.

semantics.mechanical_steps: Aggregated as supporting overhead, not individual nodes and not free. Chemical separation, chloride dehydration and gas purification remain explicit where they determine feasibility.
semantics.route_selection: Do not enable every alternative on the entire feed inventory. Source and product pools obey allocation and capacity constraints.
semantics.inputs: All listed inputs of a recipe are AND requirements. Multiple producers of a material are OR/additive supply choices.
semantics.inventories: Installed working media/catalysts/assemblies need initial charge, make-up and replacement; they are not necessarily consumed stoichiometrically.
semantics.purity: Product identity is not purity. No stream is qualified until its consumer-specific limits and measured/predicted impurity balance are assigned.
semantics.unknowns: None means unknown, never zero. All routes are disabled for numerical optimisation until mass, quality, utility and equipment parameters are assigned.
semantics.dag: Single-pass/time-expanded dependency view. Recovery outlets go to future-batch inventory and do not connect to fresh input stocks in this DAG.
semantics.water_budget: Water and derived H2/O2 are finite allocated streams. Imported mediator atoms and startup inventories cannot be counted as newly extracted asteroid resource.
semantics.source_inventory: Mineral-source nodes are reusable families. Fractions live in taxonomy_scenarios and per-object class references, not globally on an ore node.
semantics.equations: Balanced ideal endmember templates only; not whole-ore species balances or certified recoveries.
semantics.equipment: Major nontrivial modules and critical imported/manufactured subassemblies. No complete BOM, construction plan or local equipment manufacture is claimed.
semantics.class_filter: Candidate routes are gated by main-feed mineral ancestry and required class-level elemental inventory. All chemical grades/recoveries remain unqualified.
semantics.imports: Imported qualified water/H2/O2/carbon/Mg/Al may substitute only after satisfying the selected stream specification. Such supply choices are not free material creation.
semantics.all_routes_status: This is a candidate catalogue, not a claim every class can produce every product. New refractory, Ca/Na, phosphide and other placeholders are explicitly blocked.
semantics.physical_procedures: See procedure_audit profiles. Literature-supported unit chemistry is distinct from a complete, qualified asteroid processing plant.
semantics.output_credit: All outputs remain unqualified. Indigenous resource credit additionally requires per-element input-origin and stream-allocation balances.
semantics.blocked_routes: Blocked records are gap markers, not executable transformations; exclude their product edges from feasible-path searches.
semantics.physical_separation: Mechanical preparation remains aggregated. Phase separation is a feasibility gate where low gravity, chemistry or purity makes it nontrivial.
semantics.pass_through: If a target element is absent, design a qualified liquor bypass rather than requiring that element to precipitate or inventing its product.
semantics.derived_scopes: Main-feed ancestry is a discovery index only: it does not test all auxiliary supplies, stream-specific element provenance or plant feasibility.

source_catalogue_entry.extraction: Magnetic separation, then reduction (e.g. hydrogen or carbon) to iron

source_catalogue_entry.name: Native iron-nickel metal (kamacite/taenite)
source_catalogue_entry.extraction: Magnetic separation; carbonyl (Mond) process separates Fe, Ni, Co and leaves PGM residue. PGMs are dissolved in this phase (see trace_elements)

source_catalogue_entry.name: Iron/nickel sulfides (troilite, pyrrhotite, pentlandite)
source_catalogue_entry.extraction: Roasting/smelting; sulfur recovered as SO2 or elemental S

source_catalogue_entry.name: Carbonates (dolomite, calcite)
source_catalogue_entry.extraction: Heating (calcination) releases CO2; residue is CaO/MgO

source_catalogue_entry.name: Insoluble organic matter (kerogen-like)
source_catalogue_entry.extraction: Pyrolysis yields hydrocarbons, CO/CO2 and N-compounds: feedstock for fuel and plastics

source_catalogue_entry.name: Olivine
source_catalogue_entry.extraction: Molten oxide electrolysis to release oxygen and metals; bulk use as construction/shielding material

source_catalogue_entry.name: Plagioclase feldspar
source_catalogue_entry.extraction: Main aluminium ore in space; acid leaching or molten electrolysis

source_catalogue_entry.name: Chromite
source_catalogue_entry.extraction: Gravity/magnetic separation, then reduction; used for stainless steel

source_catalogue_entry.name: Ilmenite
source_catalogue_entry.extraction: Hydrogen reduction yields iron, TiO2 and water/oxygen

source_catalogue_entry.name: Phosphates (merrillite/apatite)
source_catalogue_entry.extraction: Acid leaching; phosphorus for fertiliser/life support

source_catalogue_entry.extraction: Treated as waste rock / regolith filler

edges.condition: only if selected feed requires activation; otherwise use a qualified alternative activation recipe

semantics.mechanical_steps: Aggregated as supporting overhead, not individual nodes and not free. Chemical separation, chloride dehydration and gas purification remain explicit where they determine feasibility.
semantics.route_selection: Do not enable every alternative on the entire feed inventory. Source and product pools obey allocation and capacity constraints.
semantics.inputs: All listed inputs of a recipe are AND requirements. Multiple producers of a material are OR/additive supply choices.
semantics.inventories: Installed working media/catalysts/assemblies need initial charge, make-up and replacement; they are not necessarily consumed stoichiometrically.
semantics.purity: Product identity is not purity. No stream is qualified until its consumer-specific limits and measured/predicted impurity balance are assigned.
semantics.unknowns: None means unknown, never zero. All routes are disabled for numerical optimisation until mass, quality, utility and equipment parameters are assigned.
semantics.dag: Single-pass/time-expanded dependency view. Recovery outlets go to future-batch inventory and do not connect to fresh input stocks in this DAG.
semantics.water_budget: Water and derived H2/O2 are finite allocated streams. Imported mediator atoms and startup inventories cannot be counted as newly extracted asteroid resource.
semantics.source_inventory: Mineral-source nodes are reusable families. Fractions live in taxonomy_scenarios and per-object class references, not globally on an ore node.
semantics.equations: Balanced ideal endmember templates only; not whole-ore species balances or certified recoveries.
semantics.equipment: Major nontrivial modules and critical imported/manufactured subassemblies. No complete BOM, construction plan or local equipment manufacture is claimed.
semantics.class_filter: Candidate routes are gated by main-feed mineral ancestry and required class-level elemental inventory. All chemical grades/recoveries remain unqualified.
semantics.imports: Imported qualified water/H2/O2/carbon/Mg/Al may substitute only after satisfying the selected stream specification. Such supply choices are not free material creation.
semantics.all_routes_status: This is a candidate catalogue, not a claim every class can produce every product. New refractory, Ca/Na, phosphide and other placeholders are explicitly blocked.
semantics.physical_procedures: See procedure_audit profiles. Literature-supported unit chemistry is distinct from a complete, qualified asteroid processing plant.
semantics.output_credit: All outputs remain unqualified. Indigenous resource credit additionally requires per-element input-origin and stream-allocation balances.
semantics.blocked_routes: Blocked records are gap markers, not executable transformations; exclude their product edges from feasible-path searches.
semantics.physical_separation: Mechanical preparation remains aggregated. Phase separation is a feasibility gate where low gravity, chemistry or purity makes it nontrivial.
semantics.pass_through: If a target element is absent, design a qualified liquor bypass rather than requiring that element to precipitate or inventing its product.
semantics.derived_scopes: Main-feed ancestry is a discovery index only: it does not test all auxiliary supplies, stream-specific element provenance or plant feasibility.

procedure_audit.scope: Desk review of all process records: reaction identity, reference-feed support, consequential separations, auxiliaries, equipment and space physical assumptions.
procedure_audit.conclusion: Useful candidate supply-chain catalogue; not a physically validated end-to-end production model.

status_definitions.supported_unit_chemistry: Known unit transformation on specified feed; actual recipe, space plant and grade still unqualified.
status_definitions.reference_feed_demonstration: Experimental support on stated analogue/reference feed; no universal transfer to a taxonomy class.
status_definitions.conditional_flowsheet: Plausible chemistry or unit technologies; actual feed-specific separation/operating recipe incomplete.
status_definitions.research_route: ISRU research/development; extrapolation and products require further validation.
status_definitions.blocked_incomplete_route: No executable complete procedure selected; retain as a gap and do not credit output products.
status_definitions.assay_or_conditioning_only: Sampling/conditioning or relabelling, not elemental extraction or enrichment.

clay_thermal.finding: Thermal water release is demonstrated for specified carbonaceous analogues; free/interlayer water and structural OH have different release curves. The equation is only an Mg-serpentine endmember.
unresolved_engineering_gates: dehydroxylated phases may be harder to leach

water_polishing.finding: Recovered water is a contaminated candidate stream. Ice extraction and polishing depend on co-volatiles and the consuming process specification.

water_electrolysis.finding: Water electrolysis produces H2/O2 on qualified feed. Reduction-water recovery also needs purification. Stack chemistry does not remove feed contaminants automatically.

iron_reduction.finding: H2 reduces iron oxides through temperature-dependent phases. Solid iron is a candidate product; oxygen first leaves as water, not O2.

silicate_leach.finding: Acid-attack endmember equations are plausible, but serpentinite results cannot establish recovery or kinetics for every altered clay, olivine or pyroxene.

carbonate_calcination.finding: Carbonates can yield oxides and CO2, often stepwise. Temperature and residual CO2 pressure govern decomposition; gas identity is not product-grade qualification.
unresolved_engineering_gates: CO2 partial pressure and heat transfer

oxide_acid_dissolution.finding: HCl dissolves accessible Ca/Mg/Fe/Ni oxides. Mixed ferrites, spinels, gangue and residual sulfides can change dissolution and impurity behaviour.

sulfide_roast.finding: Oxidative roasting is established, but the FeS equation is not a whole pentlandite/pyrrhotite balance. Sulfates, ferrites and incomplete desulfurisation are possible.

sulfide_acid.finding: Reactive FeS can dissolve in nonoxidising acid to release H2S; this does not establish the same Ni recovery from every mixed sulfide.

sour_gas_quality.finding: H2S feed must be separated from water, acid aerosol and other gases to the selected sulfur-recovery specification.

claus.finding: Partial H2S combustion supplies SO2 for catalytic sulfur recovery. The branches require controlled allocation and a 2:1 H2S:SO2 molar ratio at the catalytic reaction.
unresolved_engineering_gates: catalyst life and residual sulfur gases

iron_oxidation.finding: Oxidation of dissolved Fe(II) to Fe(III) is plausible; oxygen transfer and chloride/acid speciation determine rate and precipitation response.

multimetal_precipitation.finding: Hydroxide formation is valid chemistry; sequential precipitation is not a guaranteed pure Fe/Ni/Mg splitter. Co-precipitation, entrainment and overlapping solubilities need measured partition curves.
required_physical_operations: staged base dosing and pH/Eh control
unresolved_engineering_gates: bypass design when a feed contains no target element

hydroxide_calcination.finding: Specified hydroxides can dehydrate to oxides; ferric precipitate may be oxyhydroxide rather than ideal Fe(OH)3, and coprecipitated impurities remain.

nickel_reduction.finding: Thermal H2 reduction is supported on specified NiO feeds. The earlier mechanochemical citation alone did not validate the selected thermal furnace.

magnesia_chlorination.finding: MgO reacts with HCl to produce Mg chloride solution. Solution concentration and impurities still determine subsequent dehydration requirements.

MgCl2_drying.finding: Anhydrous low-oxygen chloride preparation is a real bottleneck: uncontrolled hydrate heating produces hydroxychloride/oxide. HCl-assisted dehydration needs acid-gas recovery.

Mg_electrolysis.finding: Dry molten Mg chloride gives Mg and chlorine on appropriate electrodes/bath. Neither oxygen nor stoichiometric carbon consumption is part of the ideal chloride reaction.

Ca_separation.finding: No actual selective Ca/Na/Mg separation recipe or phase-equilibrium basis is specified. A generic crystalliser does not close this gap.
required_physical_operations: select and test an actual salt separation

Ca_drying.finding: Drying is chemically plausible, but the upstream CaCl2 separation is blocked and the selected cell moisture limit is missing.

Ca_electrolysis.finding: Fused CaCl2 electrolysis is a known route. This catalogue does not select a complete calcium cell or resolve metal solubility/collection and upstream feed purification.
unresolved_engineering_gates: solid or liquid Ca collection as actually selected

silica_purification.finding: Alkali dissolution and acid precipitation are supported for selected silica residues. Crystalline quartz and different silicates need different attack conditions; trace B/P/metals may remain.

silicon_furnace.finding: Carbothermic silicon manufacture is established with qualified quartz/reductants. The overall equation hides SiO/SiC intermediates, fume and slag losses; the output is metallurgical silicon.

chlorosilanes.finding: Industrial Si-to-TCS purification and H2 CVD are supported. Identity of deposited silicon does not guarantee semiconductor grade, and polysilicon is not a fabricated device or solar cell.

organic_conversion.finding: Thermal conversion/gasification is supported on tested analogues. Product fractions and nitrogen/sulfur partition are feed- and operating-condition dependent, not fixed by an empirical organic formula.

syngas_cleanup.finding: Contaminant removal and gas separation are established unit technologies, but the selected MDEA/Ni/ZnO train is not demonstrated for every asteroid feed.

char_grade.finding: Acid washing can lower mineral ash; it does not remove all bonded S/N/O or establish furnace reductant, electrode, graphite or battery-carbon grade.

methane.finding: Sabatier conversion and methane pyrolysis are supported routes with different thermal requirements. Cracking methane returns H2 but requires energy and carbon handling.
required_physical_operations: catalytic methanation and heat removal or selected methane cracking reactor

ammonia_recovery.finding: Only measured ammoniacal nitrogen is eligible for this route; an organic N total does not specify recoverable NH3.

ammonia_cracking.finding: NH3 can decompose catalytically into N2 and H2. Unconverted ammonia and gas separation need explicit handling.

contact_acid.finding: The contact route is sound: clean dry SO2/O2, catalytic oxidation, then SO3 absorption in strong acid with controlled water addition. Direct SO3/water contact is not the selected absorber procedure.

HCl_recovery.finding: Controlled H2/Cl2 synthesis and absorption can make HCl. This is reagent regeneration consuming H2 and water inventory, with concentration and capture losses.

brine_softening.finding: Primary softening plus secondary ion exchange is a supported architecture. Actual resin, breakthrough limits, regenerant doses and any anion removal remain to be designed.
unresolved_engineering_gates: sulfate/other anions not removed by cation resin

chloralkali.finding: Qualified concentrated NaCl brine can produce NaOH/H2/Cl2 in a membrane cell. Mixed process brine is not automatically suitable feed.

MRE.finding: Oxygen-evolving molten-oxide electrolysis is an ISRU development route. Mixed metal/alloy and residual slag are credible product categories; pure Fe/Si/Al/Mg/Ca/Ti splits are not established here.

native_alloy.finding: Native metal may be useful as an alloy after assay; homogenisation is not elemental separation or structural-material certification.

native_acid.finding: Acid dissolution of reactive Fe/Ni is plausible; alloy passivation and inclusions change behaviour. H2 released here obtains its hydrogen from acid, not the native metal.

cobalt_SX.finding: Cyanex 272 supports Co/Ni separation from chloride or sulfate media; pH and competing cations control selectivity. Sulfuric-acid stripping does not itself establish a qualified electrowinning electrolyte.

cobalt_EW.finding: Co electrowinning is plausible from qualified electrolyte; the ideal oxygen-evolution equation assumes a compatible insoluble anode. Acid/oxygen recovery is not separately qualified.

plagioclase_leach.finding: Anorthite digestion has laboratory support; albite-rich and other feeds need separate testwork. The cited 2025 cell used stock alumina, not this complete selected flowsheet.
required_physical_operations: contained pressurised acid digestion as selected
unresolved_engineering_gates: feed-specific activation including fluoride if selected

refractory_leach.finding: Balanced spinel/melilite/perovskite attack templates do not demonstrate that mixed refractory inclusions dissolve at useful rates or yield separated TiO2.
required_physical_operations: phase-resolved attack testwork before selecting a process

Al_chloride.finding: HCl-assisted AlCl3 hydrate isolation and thermal conversion are candidate alumina routes. Calcium aluminates/basic chlorides and residual chlorides can reduce yield and quality.

Al_electrolysis.finding: The selected recipe is carbon-anode Hall-Heroult using qualified alumina and fluoride bath. CO2/CO, rather than an O2 coproduct, accompany anode consumption.

ilmenite_reduction.finding: Hydrogen removal of ilmenite Fe-bound oxygen is experimentally supported. Titanium suboxides and residual ilmenite can coexist with Fe; it is not pure Ti metal production.

ilmenite_split.finding: The reduction product can be an intergrown Fe/titanium-oxide composite. No selected liberation/separation flowsheet establishes two qualified products.
required_physical_operations: select/test liberation and separation or a chemical alternative
unresolved_engineering_gates: TiO2 chlorinator-feed and iron impurity limits

titanium.finding: Industrial chlorination, TiCl4 purification, Mg reduction and vacuum Mg/salt removal are supported. Sponge is an intermediate requiring further processing/qualification for spacecraft structures.
unresolved_engineering_gates: replace gravity drainage with a specified collection design

ferrochrome.finding: Carbothermic chromite reduction makes alloy/carbidic ferrochrome. The Fe and Cr in the ideal reaction are not separate pure-metal products.

chromate.finding: Chromate/dichromate/oxide chemistry and aluminothermic Cr production are known routes. The chosen sulfur-derived oxide may require further purification before metallurgical use.
required_physical_operations: controlled thermite reaction and slag separation
unresolved_engineering_gates: CO2 carbon originates in soda ash

phosphate_wet.finding: Sulfuric-acid attack of apatite is established. Merrillite endmember stoichiometry is not a tested industrial recipe, and fluoride partitions among gas, acid and solids.

P_acid_purification.finding: The record names solvent extraction but selects no solvent formulation or operating recipe. It cannot establish pure phosphoric acid or electronic-grade phosphorus.
unresolved_engineering_gates: solvent identity, makeup and distribution data
acid concentration, entrainment and quality specification

phosphorus_thermal.finding: Phosphate/silica/carbon electric-furnace phosphorus production is established. Real feeds also generate slag, dust and potentially ferrophosphorus; purified P4 needs controlled collection.
required_physical_operations: P vapour condensation and protected collection

phosphide.finding: Published corrosion demonstrates mixed phosphorus species, not the proposed rapid peroxide/acid extraction and selective P/Fe/Ni recovery. No qualified product path is credited.
required_physical_operations: research on redox/speciation and gas formation

precious_assay.finding: An assay can identify a possible refinery feed; it does not enrich PGM/Au or establish selective recovery. Only the physically sampled residue can be relabelled.

shared_physical_engineering_requirements: Choose local acceleration/rotation and model phase contact and withdrawal; terrestrial settling, buoyancy and drainage are not assumed.
Select compatible pressure boundary, seals, pumps, wetted materials and corrosion allowances for the actual chemicals/temperature.
Include heating/cooling, radiator area and working-fluid inventories; vacuum is not unlimited useful cooling.
Contain dust, corrosive/toxic gases and volatile metal species; select capture, leak and purge budgets.
Measure conversion, phase partition and impurity carryover; no pure outlet follows from a chemical equation alone.

Selected operating conditions and phase/equilibrium/kinetic model

Measured/predicted impurity limits at every consuming node

Independent bench/pilot validation before claiming physical production capability
evidence_limitations: Source support is assigned at the unit or feed level; broad technology references do not validate this assembled network.
No source establishes this complete asteroid taxonomy-to-pure-products plant operating in space.
Ideal endmember atom balances exclude many real phases/side reactions; no whole-ore mass balance is claimed.
No product purity, recovery, cost, throughput or energy value has been certified by this review.
